amendment_reason: E2 2x2 ablation design-defect fix (outcome-blind, not driven by any observed E1-E3 effect): production and decay form a balanced source-sink pair. v2 locked only the global wealth_decay_rate=0.02 and did not account for terrain_production_enabled=false, where production=0 while decay still drains wealth to exponential collapse (the same mathematical root cause as the E1 flat-terrain bug). Fix: a cell with terrain_production_enabled=false gets wealth_decay_rate=0 (closing the source also closes its paired sink), so all four E2 cells are stationary and the 2x2 factorial analysis is unbiased. E1's four conditions are all production-enabled, so its parameters and the supported C2-LANDSCAPE verdict are unchanged.
finalized_note: E1 passed (C2-LANDSCAPE supported). CPU budget approved 2026-09-05: execute E2-CHANNEL-ABLATION only, then decide E3 on its evidence.

channel_pairing_policy.description: The production channel is a balanced source-sink pair: production (source) plus proportional wealth decay (sink). In E2's 2x2 ablation, a cell with terrain_production_enabled=false sets wealth_decay_rate=0 (closing the source also closes its paired sink) so wealth is conserved rather than exponentially drained to zero. With terrain_production_enabled=true, wealth_decay_rate keeps its locked value 0.02. This pairing applies to E2 only; E1 and E3 use production=true everywhere.

amendment_policy: Before finalization, amendments may use only runtime, numerical stability and outcome-blind health diagnostics. After finalization or after E1 execution starts, any change creates a new lock version and research cycle; observed E1-E3 effects may not be used to amend this lock.
